decisions.reason: As a core coolant-management launch that fits the firm's stated automation and efficiency direction, the investment and visible commitment already made make management very unlikely to reverse course in the next year.

Because the nozzle line extends the established coolant portfolio across several models and can be justified as part of broader system sales, management is inclined to retain it rather than admit the launch was premature.

This magnetic belt chip conveyor sits squarely within the firm's established conveying business, so prior engineering and commercialization effort support continued backing unless results become clearly untenable.

Although somewhat more adjacent and easier to rationalize than the most central coolant products, the firm has already committed resources to this conveyor and would likely give it more time before withdrawing it.
